title: Applied Research Seminar
description: Engages students in the cycle of applied research design. Students examine, develop, apply and assess a range of applied research methods. Students collect and analyze various forms of data on their research topic and regularly consult with their supervisory committee throughout the course. A critical, decolonial, social justice and intersectional lens is applied to considerations of research ethics, power, reflexivity, methodological diversity and knowledge generation and mobilization.
notes: CYC 553 Practicum in CYFCS can be taken concurrently.
